mapper.sql: f.id, f.student_id, f.category, f.amount, f.semester, f.family_income, f.difficulty_level, f.reason, f.status, f.counselor_id, f.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , s.name AS student_name, s.student_no AS student_no, u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM student_record f LEFT JOIN student s ON f.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.counselor_id = u.id WHERE f.record_type = 'AID' AND f.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_record (record_type, student_id, category, amount, semester, family_income, difficulty_level, reason, status, counselor_id) VALUES ('AID', #{studentId}, #{aidType}, #{amount}, #{semester}, #{familyIncome}, #{difficultyLevel}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{counselorId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_record WHERE record_type = 'AID' AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_record WHERE record_type = 'AID' AND status = #{status}
